correctness.rationale: For q_i>=2, d>=2 and at least one even q_i, M=(d+1)I+sum J_i over F2. Odd J_i split into 0/1 eigenspaces of dimensions q_i-1/1; even J_i have one 2-block and q_i-2 zero blocks, and a contracting homotopy shows ker N=im N on every summand containing a 2-block. Parity extraction yields ((P_E+R_E)/2)((P_O+(-1)^(d+1)R_O)/2), including empty products. An explicit all-on solution covers both parities of the number of even factors. The uniqueness boundary and K_2r x K_3 gap follow. Independently rebuilt 109 toggle matrices by GF2 elimination, all matching the formula; finite checks corroborate, do not prove all sizes.
